name: wayfarer-monorepo
description: Wayfarer — Honest Ratings, Fair Bookings: Travel discovery and concurrency-safe guided-tour booking platform

scripts.setup: npm run db:setup && npm run build
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run --workspace=@wayfarer/shared build && npm run --workspace=@wayfarer/api build && npm run --workspace=@wayfarer/web build
